name: PageRoot
install: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium

terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Web dev server (vinext/Vite on http://localhost:3000) plus the workspace bridge on 127.0.0.1:4317. The first page/module request may return 500 or fail a dynamic import while Vite optimizes dependencies on cold start; reload once it settles. This serves the web renderer shell, which is what Linux/cloud and CI exercise. The full editing canvas requires the Electron desktop host (window.htmlAIRuntime/htmlAIProjects/...), which per docs/DEVELOPMENT.md targets macOS via `npm run desktop:dev`; in a plain browser the canvas shows the expected “桌面运行环境未初始化” notice.
